evidence.title: The effect of niacinamide on reducing cutaneous pigmentation and suppression of melanosome transfer
evidence.excerpt: 5% niacinamide moisturizer significantly decreased hyperpigmentation; niacinamide inhibited melanosome transfer from melanocytes to keratinocytes in vitro.

evidence.title: Improvement of naturally aged skin with vitamin A (retinol)
evidence.excerpt: Topical 0.4% retinol applied up to 12 weeks significantly improved fine wrinkling associated with natural aging.

evidence.title: Topical L-ascorbic acid: percutaneous absorption studies
evidence.excerpt: L-ascorbic acid must be formulated at pH below 3.5 for optimal percutaneous absorption; 20% was the maximum concentration for skin absorption.

evidence.title: Efficacy of cream-based novel formulations of hyaluronic acid of different molecular weights in anti-wrinkle treatment
evidence.excerpt: Creams containing 0.1% hyaluronic acid of various molecular weights significantly improved skin hydration and elasticity.

evidence.title: 化妆品安全技术规范（2015年版）表4 化妆品准用防腐剂

evidence.excerpt: 苯氧乙醇（Phenoxyethanol）为化妆品准用防腐剂，最大允许使用浓度 1.0%。
